name: Cooper's at Bear Lake West Roasted Chicken or Mashed Potato Side
brandOrRestaurant: Cooper's Restaurant & Sports Bar (Fish Haven / Bear Lake, ID)
whyItWorks: Simple roasted chicken breast or tenderloin paired with whipped mashed potatoes or a baked potato gives you a calm dinner option on the Idaho side of Bear Lake.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Roasted/Grilled Chicken with a baked potato (eat the inside) or mashed potatoes, holding any black pepper crust or raw salad.
watchOuts: Mashed potatoes contain butter and milk—choose a plain baked potato if strictly dairy-free
